userStories.title: platform_ask_human — park, notify, return
userStories.description: 3-file platform-tool pattern: platform_ask_human(subject_type, subject_id, question, options?, expires_hours?). Handler: validates the subject exists in the caller's workspace; parks it — board task → status 'blocked' + blocked_reason 'Awaiting human answer (ask #N)' + blocked_at (mirror the approval gate pattern at api/board_tasks.py:1074-1082); playbook_run/tool_call subjects follow the grant precedent (re-verify how tool_grants.py:372-426 parks a tool call and mirror it with kind='question'); inserts the question-kind row (question_md required, markdown; asked_by_agent_id from caller context — server-injected, never a tool param); dispatches NEW event type 'question_pending' through NotificationDispatcher (add to VALID_EVENT_TYPES; in_app + configured external destinations; link_type='question', link_id=row id); computes the downstream-blocked count (transitive dependents via parent_task_id + OrchestrationTaskDependency, cycle-safe) and marks the notification urgent when ≥3 (the baked quiet-hours bypass); RETURNS IMMEDIATELY with {ask_id, parked: true} — the tool never waits. userStories.title: Ingress trust gate — strict | communication_only | allow_all per channel
userStories.description: Per-channel trigger_mode on the EXISTING channels model config (core/models/channels.py:25 — re-verify its settings/config JSONB and extend it, rebuild-don't-mutate; NO new table/column if a settings JSONB exists, else one nullable column rides US-001's migration — do NOT create a second revision: if a column is truly required, amend the US-001 revision BEFORE it ever ran in CI is not possible mid-chain, so prefer the JSONB; a second migration file is a hard failure). Modes: strict (DEFAULT — inbound directives are HELD: create a question-kind row 'Inbound directive awaiting approval' with the message as question_md, subject=the channel row, nothing executes; approving = answering with 'route it'), communication_only (conservative classifier: unconfident ⇒ directive ⇒ held; chatter routes), allow_all (current behavior). Correlated answers (US-005 reply/answer matches) BYPASS the gate — they are responses, not directives. Classifier: pure function, deliberately conservative, unit-tested on a fixture table of directive/chatter examples. Gate decisions logged (channel id, mode, verdict — no message body in logs). Channel CRUD API exposes trigger_mode read/update via the existing channels routes (no new route).
